profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Minecraft
profile.summary:
I started working at Minecraft in January of 2016 as a software engineer and have become a subject matter expert in our UI system. I have had the privilege of working with other talented team members to create a store that supports 3rd party content using a CDN to data drive both our store layout and content. My daily role consists of working closely with art, design and feature stakeholders to implement user stories while helping onboard other devs to use our UI system, building UI infrastructure and giving code reviews for other engineers. 

My current goal is to grow my technical skills and leadership to work towards becoming a senior level engineer. 

Skills:
Languages: C, C++

Programming Areas: 
Gameplay, UI, Store, CDN, Data driving solutions

positions.description: Cold calling OEMs and System Integrators for HMI and Industrial PC solutions.

positions.description: Generating new business for Linksys/Cisco telephony installations and IT contractor services to SMB clients. Also acting as IT desktop support contractor for clients.

positions.description: Built and managed 14 distributor relationships across 1/3rd of the continental US - primarily central US and West Coast. Sold direct to large OEMs. Products offered were HMI industrial PCs and automation software solutions.

projects.title: Discofro
projects.description: Discofro is a 3D action survival brawler where the main character is attempting to keep disco alive with the powers of earth, wind and fire against the elements of heavy metal.

projects.title: Darkstar
projects.description: A 2D puzzle platformer that uses multi-directional gravity, a maintenance robot struggles to help a space ship taken over by a virus.
